北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好，体感 18℃，昼夜温差大，注意添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, feels like 18℃. Mind the day-night temp difference, dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿冷，体感 13℃，记得多穿暖和点哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is gloomy and damp, feels like 13℃. Remember to dress extra warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 13℃，微凉，别忘了加件外套哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 13℃. It's cool, don't forget your jacket.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州下雨，湿度 95%，出行带伞，注意防潮保暖！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is rainy with 95% humidity. Take an umbrella, stay dry and warm!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感舒适 23℃，但湿度大，注意清爽。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels comfortable at 23℃. High humidity, stay fresh.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天湿冷，体感 12℃，注意保暖，别着凉了。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hanzhou is gloomy and damp, feels like 12℃. Stay warm, avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感 10℃，风寒明显，记得多添衣！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cold and gloomy, feels like 10℃. Wind chill is noticeable, dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴好，体感 25℃，舒适宜人，尽情享受阳光吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and pleasant at 25℃. Enjoy the sunshine to the fullest!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 15℃，略有凉意，记得加件薄外套哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 15℃. It's a bit cool, remember a light jacket.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 19℃，阳光正好，出行别忘了防晒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels like 19℃. The sun is just right, don't forget sun protection!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 24℃，舒适，外出记得带水多补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels comfortable at 24℃. Remember to stay hydrated when out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 7℃，风力 3级，寒意渐浓，务必添衣保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like 7℃ with a Level 3 wind. The chill is noticeable, please dress warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 16℃，风力 3级，风大干燥，注意保湿！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 16℃ with a Level 3 wind. It's windy and dry, moisturize!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 19℃，舒适宜人，昼夜温差注意哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and pleasant at 19℃. Be mindful of the day-night temperature difference.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门中雨，体感 31℃ 闷热，湿度大，出行记得带伞！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has moderate rain, feels a muggy 31℃ with high humidity. Remember your umbrella!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 17℃，风力 2级，天气微凉，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 17℃ with a Level 2 wind. It's a bit cool, take care not to catch a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 12℃，昼夜温差大，别忘了添衣哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like 12℃. Big day-night temp difference, remember to layer up!
